column1: # NetworkedUnitCommander batch: owner | M | old | descriptor | semantic name
# This class is abstract and declares its own boolean "can X" checks on top of the base
# contract; each one is a one-line delegation to the same-named check in UnitCommander, so
# the semantics are those of the target helper (canRepair/canStop/canTargetUnit/...).
# Two rows are blank on purpose: b(Unit) duplicates the already-renamed isCommandable, and
# o(Unit) delegates to UnitCommander.m(W,P,Unit), whose precondition Unit.g() is unnamed.
# Descriptors come from javap - do not edit them.
